aspect_ratio_conventions.note: Fish 1990 Table III reports the aspect ratio of the pectoral fin (p.395); which span and area enter it is not settled here (fable-to-print v2 flags the same open definition).  Three conventions are computed so a reader can see which one the Table III fit is near.  None of them is fed to the solver by this module; the solver's AR is whatever guilds' model computes from span and area.

body_density_kg_m3.note: Fish 1990 p.399 states body density 'should be close to that of water for buoyancy stability'; 1025 kg/m^3 is a typical seawater density chosen by us, not a measured exocoetid density

fao_wca_exocoetidae.used_for: Cheilopogon furcatus sheet: dorsal 12-14, anal 8-11 soft rays (anal origin under dorsal ray 5-7), pectoral 14-17 soft rays with the first unbranched, pectoral 1.3-1.5 and pelvic 2.7-3.3 in SL, pelvic insertion nearer the opercle than the caudal base, predorsal scales 26-33 (usually 27-30), eye 2.8-3.1 in head length; family: caudal deeply forked with the lower lobe longer, pectorals high on the sides, dorsal and anal set far back with short opposed bases, scales large and cycloid, lateral line low, snout shorter than eye; Atlantic Cheilopogon head length 3.8-4.9 in SL (C. exsiliens 3.8-4.2, C. heterurus 4.3-4.9, key couplet 12 3.9-4.9)
